title: 2015 HMMT February Guts Problem 8
statement:
Evaluate

\[\sin (\arcsin (0.4)+\arcsin (0.5)) \cdot \sin (\arcsin (0.5)-\arcsin (0.4))\]

where for \(x \in[-1,1], \arcsin (x)\) denotes the unique real number \(y \in[-\pi, \pi]\) such that \(\sin (y)=x\).

solutions.text: 0.09 OR \(\frac{9}{100}\) Use the difference of squares identity \({ }^{11} \sin (a-b) \sin (a+b)=\sin (a)^{2}-\sin (b)^{2}\) to get \(0.5^{2}-0.4^{2}=0.3^{2}=0.09=\frac{9}{100}\).
